text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Afternoon classes are sooo draining. Iwanna go hooome...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thwup thwup thwup thwup!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Argh, what's that noise?! ...A<n>helicopter?! Coming
this way? Are you<n>kidding me?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Furl the sails, ye scallywags! Lower the<n>anchor!
We're mooring this vessel!

text_block_list.name: Директор Акикава
text_block_list.text:
Wrong idea! This isn't a ship, it's my<n>private
helicopter!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yarrr, don't stress the details. It's like<n>how soy
sauce and writing ink are<n>members of the same
family!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Wait, that doesn't make any<n>sense. What's
going on here?

text_block_list.name: Директор Акикава
text_block_list.text:
I spotted her—couldn't believe my eyes<n>at first,
but she was swimming<n>backstroke across the
Pacific before I<n>pulled her up!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: It turned into a real showdown once Iswitched to front crawl!

text_block_list.name: Директор Акикава
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, all this has really put me behind<n>schedule!
I have to hurry to a meeting.<n>You should all return
to your classrooms!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Lame. I'm going back.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whoa there, are your veins filled with<n>ectoplasm
or something? You're in such<n>a sorry state that
kicking your butt<n>wouldn't even be fun.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Geez... Here, let me take you to a<n>fantabulous
establishment.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Fantabulous?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sizzle!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Welcome to Li'l Golshi's Barbecue Joint!<n>
Table for one!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
We take this and that from this transient<n>world of
the living, then purify it into<n>grilled ribs, tripe,
and beef tongue!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Beg pardon? Are you underestimating<n>Li'l
Golshi's? Well then, I reckon the<n>time's come for
my sweet ride to do its<n>thing!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Sweet ride? ...Wait, you mean that<n>helicopter?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh, this baby's flappers bear a whole<n>'nother
name—the Despair-Banishing<n>Wings of Glory!
...Basically, we're talking<n>about a wicked large
ventilation fan<n>here.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
We can use this beaut to blow all that<n>blasted
smoke to kingdom come! Time<n>to crank the
engine!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: WhirrrBWAAAAA!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: This just makes it even more obvious!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Директор Акикава immediately notices<n>Gold Ship's
"restaurant" and gives her a<n>severe scolding.
